gate_descriptions.CR01_D03_ADVISORY_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_PA: A remediated qwen3.7-max review and separate deepseek-v4-pro review report zero remaining architecture blockers; these are advisory evidence only.

gate_descriptions.PR36_CLOSED_UNMERGED_CONFIRMED: Gateway PR #36 was read-only verified CLOSED, draft and unmerged at head 3b8356d90b5eea3a0056e4672fdd7be077ec8177.

gate_descriptions.FUTURE_PRODUCTION_CLEAN_GENESIS_PRINCIPL: A future production ledger must start independently at sequence one after separate Paid Beta authorization and cannot inherit legacy chain, sequence or signature exceptions.
gate_descriptions.BUILD_VERSUS_ADOPT_AUDIT_COMPLETE: Fifteen upstream candidates were reviewed from official sources; eight are recommended, six are conditional and one is deferred by score. Seven runtime introductions remain deferred to explicit triggers.
gate_descriptions.FINAL_FORM_IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION_PACKE: The seven-layer architecture and P0/P1/P2 backlog were prepared for Human review; this historical gate did not itself create implementation authority.

gate_descriptions.D29_SYNTHETIC_OBSERVER_FIRST_VALUE_REFER: Gateway CE-2 executes a zero-customer-data Observer, Shadow Gate, Receipt verification and Audit timeline for one fixed synthetic scenario.
gate_descriptions.D29_READ_ONLY_CONSOLE_REFERENCE_COMPLETE: Gateway CE-3 and CE-4 expose Agent-readable read-only projections and Human pages derived from the same projections; the Console is not deployed.
gate_descriptions.D29_SOFTWARE_DELIVERY_PROOF_SYNTHETIC_CO: Gateway CE-5 compares no-Gate, Monitor and Enforce paths using existing Gate, Receipt and Audit code without a provider action or real customer authorization.
gate_descriptions.D29_CE1_CE5_CLEAN_CLONE_PASS: Canonical Gateway main c02926397563940feeba54b1efbe8d62e406e0e8 passed source tests and clean-clone validation in the declared synthetic reference context.
gate_descriptions.D29_COMMERCIAL_DELIVERY_DOCUMENTATION_FO: Four offering drafts, an unpriced RMB cost model, seventeen legal drafts, support, design-partner, onboarding, exit and China business-readiness documents exist. They create no price, contract, outreach, customer access, payment, deployment or commercial availability.
gate_descriptions.D29_SALES_MATERIALS_COMPLETE_INTERNAL_DR: All twelve required D29 sales artifacts exist as internal drafts. They are not authorized to send and create no quote, offer, contract or customer fact.
gate_descriptions.D29_MULTI_AGENT_SESSION_THRESHOLDS_PASS_: Ten valid sessions across four providers, five model families and three sanitized entry surfaces passed the D29 threshold after retaining and remediating two invalid responses. Live public commercial discovery still returns 404 and customer adoption remains unproven.
gate_descriptions.D29_PRIVATE_SECURITY_EVALUATION_KIT_READ: A public-safe private evaluation kit references architecture and threat boundaries, synthetic vectors, deployment, limitations and rollback. No evaluator is assigned or contacted and no security PASS exists.
gate_descriptions.D29_DURABLE_EVIDENCE_READ_PROJECTION_REF: Gateway main ddbbb724b6a74eca81cf96773bbc9a6a772ae814 keeps Tenant/Workspace/Agent-bound Receipt reads and verifies the complete declared Workspace Audit scope against every canonical Tenant-chain link. Unrelated Tenant event content remains omitted, offline excluded-event non-membership is not cryptographically proven, and no deployment or offering is created.
gate_descriptions.D29_SECURITY_ENGINEERING_GATE_MAPPED_FAI: Gateway main ddbbb724b6a74eca81cf96773bbc9a6a772ae814 maps 20 D29 security controls: 16 PASS, 1 PARTIAL, 1 FAIL_RETAINED, 1 NOT_ASSESSED and 1 NOT_APPLICABLE. One Blocker and two High findings remain open, so this remains fail closed, not a complete security pass or commercial authorization.
gate_descriptions.D29_DURABLE_CREDENTIAL_LIFECYCLE_REFEREN: Gateway PR #53 merged offline durable D29 credential rotation and revocation at 8e4d9636ace647b8d6daacd77223900db6d862db. Source and ephemeral PostgreSQL CI passed; no network administration endpoint, customer self-service or deployment was created.
gate_descriptions.D29_WORKSPACE_AUDIT_EXPORT_REFERENCE_COM: Gateway PR #54 merged at 5549259a733ce5c7520d85b26936a98fd7317a3b. Source and ephemeral PostgreSQL CI passed the complete declared Workspace-scope export and Audit tamper control; canonical Tenant event content remains intentionally incomplete, external anchoring is absent, and no deployment was created.
gate_descriptions.D29_WORKSPACE_DATA_LIFECYCLE_REFERENCE_C: Gateway PR #55 merged at ddbbb724b6a74eca81cf96773bbc9a6a772ae814. Source and ephemeral PostgreSQL CI passed bounded Workspace deletion and retention lifecycle controls. The path revokes Workspace access, redacts mutable customer references, retains declared immutable evidence exceptions, stores no raw customer content, and creates no customer self-service, schema, migration, API, service or deployment.
gate_descriptions.D29_SECURITY_DRILL_READINESS_PACKET_COMP: Gateway PR #56 merged at e200ea0f00d9d948c3b6dbf7058e08489dea1ccd. It adds only a bounded incident and rollback drill readiness contract, Human decision packet and regression tests. No drill, deployment, restart or finding closure occurred; the security gate remains FAIL_CLOSED with one Blocker and two High findings.
gate_descriptions.D29_SECURITY_DRILLS_EXECUTED_PASS_AUTHOR: Gateway PR #58 merged at 1a065f1702e355d5f5ed566bdfd3e895cdca2540 after the bounded live incident and formal rollback drills passed. Incident recovery measured 2166 ms, rollback 2604 ms and forward recovery 2012 ms; exact current release was restored and temporary authority was closed.
gate_descriptions.D29_HIGH_SECURITY_FINDINGS_CLOSED_2: The incident-drill and formal-rollback-drill High findings are closed by executed evidence. This does not constitute an independent security evaluation, SLA, production readiness or commercial authorization.
gate_descriptions.D29_CR01_BLOCKER_DISPOSED_FAILED_RETAINE: The open CR01 action is disposed by retaining the immutable 1661 historical synthetic Receipt ledger outside any future D29 launch baseline. The two unverifiable Receipts remain unchanged, D04 remains CLOSED_FAILED_RETAINED and security control D29-SEC-11 remains FAIL_RETAINED.
gate_descriptions.D29_SUPPORT_OWNER_AND_SECURITY_CONTACT_A: Human decision TITMAS-D29-SECURITY-FINDINGS-20260812-01 assigns human:zhangbin as Support Owner and Security Contact through the recorded review and expiry gates. A second-person backup remains unassigned; no SLA or customer support commitment is activated.
gate_descriptions.D29_AGENT_ONLY_SECURITY_ADVISORY_COMPLET: A sanitized Agent-only review attempted nine calls across five Providers. Three Schema-valid reviews from Qwen, ERNIE and DeepSeek agreed on NOT_RECOMMENDED and FAIL_CLOSED; one Kimi response was Schema-invalid and five call failures were retained. This is not a formal independent security audit and closes no finding.
gate_descriptions.D29_LIVE_PUBLIC_SURFACE_REVERIFIED_FAIL_: On 2026-08-08, seven catalog routes and fourteen bounded Human routes were reachable. Six catalogs were byte-identical to current DBA source, while /status.json remained stale and source-inconsistent and four collection routes were unavailable. Historical Agent discovery failure remains retained; no deployment or commercial availability was created.
gate_descriptions.D29_WEBSITE_SOURCE_CORRECTION_MERGED_NOT: DBA PR #138 merged at 92a33698899153aed424cd7b756e0accca56b6be. It adds four bilingual collection entries, corrects expired E01 access truth, pins the remediated production dependency, and preserves explicit non-availability boundaries. No deployment, customer contact, offering activation or commercial authorization occurred.
